rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a jump or plunge into water, including a sporting dive.

example.traditional: 呢個跳水動作真係好靚。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 tiu3 seoi2 dung6 zok3 zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for jumping head-first into water.

example.english: I saw Ming dive from the three-metre platform, and his form was great.
example.traditional: 我見到阿明喺三米台跳水，姿勢好靚。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gin3 dou2 aa3 ming4 hai2 saam1 mai5 toi4 tiu3 seoi2 zi1 sai3 hou2 leng3

rows.note: Use this for a footballer or other player deliberately falling after a challenge to win a foul.

example.english: They dive even though nobody touched them, just to win a foul.
example.traditional: 佢明明冇俾人掂到都照插水呃犯規。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ming4 ming4 mou5 bei2 jan4 dim6 dou3 dou1 ziu3 caap3 seoi2 aak1 faan6 kwai1

rows.note: Use this for swimming or moving underwater rather than jumping into the water.

example.english: We dive underwater wearing flippers to look at the coral.
example.traditional: 我哋戴住蛙鞋潛水，睇吓海底啲珊瑚。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 daai3 zyu6 waa1 haai4 cim4 seoi2 tai2 haa5 hoi2 dai2 di1 saan1 wu4

rows.note: Use this in football or similar sports when a player deliberately falls to fake a foul.

example.english: They dive even when nobody touches them, making it look real.
example.traditional: 冇人掂到佢，佢都照插水，扮到好似真咁。
example.jyutping: mou5 jan4 dim3 dou2 keoi5 keoi5 dou1 ziu3 caap3 seoi2 baan6 dou3 hou2 ci5 zan1 gam3

rows.note: Use this figuratively when someone throws themselves enthusiastically into an activity or task.

example.english: They dive headfirst into learning to bake bread, researching until midnight every day.
example.traditional: 佢一頭栽落去學整麵包，日日研究到半夜。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 tau4 zoi1 lok6 heoi3 hok6 zing2 min6 baau1 jat6 jat6 jin4 gau3 dou3 bun3 je6
